summary: Smith & Nephew filed a Form 6-K announcing a $250 million first-tranche share buyback programme under a non-discretionary agreement with Merrill Lynch International, acting as riskless principal. Up to 84,988,930 ordinary shares may be repurchased by 7 September 2026, returning surplus capital to shareholders. Shares bought will be held as treasury and either cancelled or used for employee share awards. Buybacks occur on UK recognised exchanges per MAR and UK Listing Rules. No ADR repurchases. No guaranteed completion. Watch for buyback pace and any cancellation announcements.
